description: Participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, our team is developing innovative health-monitoring software for astronauts. We combine coding, data analysis, and space science to enhance astronaut safety and well-being. We’re looking for collaborative teammates skilled in software development, coding, and space tech who want to make a meaningful impact on the future of space exploration. Join us and turn creative ideas into real-world solutions!
summary: Our project, SHEILD, focuses on developing health monitoring software for astronauts during space missions. The software is designed to monitor important health parameters such as heart rate, body temperature, oxygen levels and blood pressure. It helps identify unusual changes in an astronaut’s health and provides alerts when any parameter becomes abnormal. This system aims to support continuous health monitoring, early detection of health problems and quick medical assistance. Since astronauts work in a challenging space environment where immediate medical support is limited, this software can help improve their safety, health and well-being throughout the mission.
details:
SHEILD is a health monitoring software prototype designed to monitor astronauts’ health during space missions. It focuses on important health parameters such as heart rate, blood oxygen level, body temperature and blood pressure. The system presents health information through a simple and user-friendly dashboard, helping users observe readings and identify unusual values.

The main aim is to improve health awareness, support astronaut safety and contribute to better health monitoring during space missions. Our project uses HTML, CSS and JavaScript to develop the web-based interface. We used AI tools, including ChatGPT, to assist with project planning, coding and content development. The project is creative because it combines space technology and health monitoring in one simple platform. Currently, it uses sample and simulated data, with future possibilities for real-time sensor integration.
